NoSQLServer v0.56 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Explicit object-table INSERT factory and explicit ARRAY_DELETE removal policy.

Object INSERT
-------------
- ObjectTableMapping~factory(factoryObject, factoryMessage)
- Single-row SQL INSERT is coerced to the mapping's DatabaseRow shape.
- Identity collision is checked before factory invocation.
- Factory receives the typed DatabaseRow and returns the object to append.
- All mapped getters must exist before the collection is mutated.
- BEFORE_INSERT may veto; AFTER_INSERT fires only after append succeeds.
- Missing factory is a clean statement failure.
- Multi-row object INSERT remains SQLUNSUPPORTED because no atomic factory-batch
  contract exists yet.

Object DELETE
-------------
- ObjectTableMapping~removal("ARRAY_DELETE") explicitly authorises array removal.
- Matching object indexes are captured before mutation.
- Deletion occurs in descending array-index order so shifts cannot corrupt the
  target set.
- BEFORE_DELETE may veto; AFTER_DELETE fires only after removal.
- Missing/unknown removal policy is a clean statement failure.

Isolation / honesty
-------------------
- No reflection-based factory discovery.
- No implicit collection mutation policy.
- No object transactions.
- No DDL-to-class fiction.
- msqlshim untouched.

Regression evidence
-------------------
- 32 gates green.
- v0.56 object INSERT/DELETE smoke: PASS
- v0.55 federation: PASS
- v0.54 object UPDATE/events: PASS
- v0.53 object joins/aggregates: PASS
- v0.52 object SELECT: PASS
- actual NoSQLServerSQL class has zero references to ~storage, SysFile,
  CsvStream, YAML, table.yaml, or /tables/.
- Claude torture: 12/12 PASS
- Grok hell v1: 24/25 PASS, 0 wrong results
- Grok hell v2: 14/30 PASS, 0 wrong results
